condition.description: array_like An array whose nonzero or True entries indicate the elements of `arr` to extract.
constraints: params.condition and params.arr must have the same shape

arr.description: array_like Input array of the same size as `condition`.
constraints: params.condition and params.arr must have the same shape

output.description: ------- ndarray Rank 1 array of values from `arr` where `condition` is True.

constraints: params.condition and params.arr must have the same shape
